description: SQL migration file for avisos_leidos table. Creates sql/ directory with migracion_avisos_v2.sql containing the CREATE TABLE for avisos_leidos.
steps: Create directory sql/ at project root

Create sql/migracion_avisos_v2.sql with: CREATE TABLE avisos_leidos (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, id_aviso INT NOT NULL, matricula_alumno VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, fecha_lectura DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (id_aviso) REFERENCES avisos(id_aviso) ON DELETE CASCADE, FOREIGN KEY (matricula_alumno) REFERENCES alumnos(matricula) ON DELETE CASCADE, UNIQUE KEY unique_aviso_alumno (id_aviso, matricula_alumno), INDEX idx_matricula (matricula_alumno), INDEX idx_aviso (id_aviso)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
Add a comment at the top noting this is v2 migration and that the `leido` field in avisos table is kept for backward compatibility but individual read tracking is now in avisos_leidos
acceptance_criteria: File sql/migracion_avisos_v2.sql exists with valid SQL syntax
Table has unique constraint on (id_aviso, matricula_alumno) to prevent duplicate reads
Foreign keys reference avisos(id_aviso) and alumnos(matricula)
verification: Run php -l on all modified PHP files (none for this feature)
Visually inspect the SQL file for correctness
